definitions.MIGRATED_PROVEN: S AND E AND U (2026-10-16 architect review: a completed live run alone is not proof). N8N_NATIVE is the same bar for a lane with no cron history (registry kind n8n, no retirement tag, no cron line); a native row WITH a retirement tag is a migration. n8n-live lanes are also reported by S/E/U combination (e.g. S1E1U0 = owns + ran, output unverified). A skip on a scheduled fire of the line is told apart from an off-schedule (manual / install verification) skip.
definitions.active_cron_line: An uncommented, non-assignment line of the CURRENT `crontab -l` (same rule as lane_registry.discover_cron). A commented line is not a job.
definitions.ambiguous_effect: An effect_claims row in CLAIMED or UNKNOWN (the effect may or may not have happened).
definitions.business_process: Two levels, reported separately: (a) a WS2 family (disposition family_id, e.g. F44) = one business function implemented by one or more lanes; (b) a fabric process (config/n8n_fabric_processes.json, e.g. hermes-learning) = an ordered set of step lanes run as one n8n workflow.
definitions.cron_stood_down: A skipped_effect (owner n8n) or skipped_ownership_unknown (fail-closed) event in logs/effect_claim_events.jsonl: the wrapped cron line fired and ran nothing.
definitions.deployed: The PR's merge commit is an ancestor of the served SHA (git merge-base --is-ancestor).
definitions.disposition_row: One row of LANE_DISPOSITION_20261015.csv: one active crontab line at build time (source=crontab) or one registry lane with no crontab line (source=registry_*). The 267 MIGRATE_N8N rows are 267 rows, not 267 jobs: several rows can name one lane, and one lane can be a family slot runner for many rows.
definitions.event_trigger_state: Per config/lane_registry.json dispatch.triggers entry: LIVE_FIRING (>=1 live `e:` receipt in window), LIVE_ARMED_NOT_FIRED, SHADOW_FIRING (dispatch dry_run, >=1 dry `e:` receipt), SHADOW_NOT_FIRED, INACTIVE. clock_fallback = every clock that still fires the lane (dispatch.cron d: slots, active crontab lines).
definitions.execution (E): >=1 live RUN_DONE receipt for the lane in the window.
definitions.failure: A receipt in RUN_FAILED or RUN_TIMEOUT, or a live RUN_DONE with output verdict empty_violation/unverifiable.
definitions.incident_episode: A distinct (lane, failure class) with >=1 event in the window, failure class = breach kind / diagnosis event_type (NO_OUTPUT, UNGOVERNED, STALE_2X, ...) or run:<reason> for failed receipts. Every further event of the same episode is a DUPLICATE event.
definitions.lock_skip: A receipt in RUN_SKIPPED_LOCK (another holder had the lane's flock).
definitions.n8n_primary: The lane is on the relay live list (or is a registry scheduler.kind=n8n ACTIVE lane) AND no active cron line RUNS it (no active line, or every active line is effect-claim wrapped and stood down).
definitions.parallel: Relay-live AND >=1 live n8n receipt in the window AND an active cron line still RUNS the lane (unwrapped, or wrapped but its last wrapper event ran the command / no event yet). LIVE_LISTED_IDLE = the same with ZERO live n8n receipts in the window (n8n is permitted, not firing).
definitions.protection_mode: Effect protection qualified by ledger health and wrapper policy. FAIL_CLOSED = handover manifest names n8n, every active cron line is wrapped, and the SERVED wrapper fails closed (knows skipped_ownership_unknown): the cron copy cannot take effect even with the ledger unreadable. LEDGER_HEALTHY_ONLY = owner n8n and every line wrapped, but the served wrapper fails OPEN on an unreadable ledger (or the manifest lacks the process): protected only while the ledger answers. NO_CRON_COPY = handed over, no active cron line. UNPROTECTED_CRON_UNWRAPPED = handed over, >=1 active line unwrapped. NOT_HANDED_OVER = neither store says n8n. A manifest/ledger disagreement is reported, never reconciled (AGENTS §0 rule 5).
definitions.proven: A qualifying LIVE receipt exists: for a lane associated with the PR (a changed script is the lane's registry match, or the PR changed the lane's row in lane_registry/n8n_effect_keys/n8n_run_allowlist), a live RUN_DONE whose code_sha contains the merge commit and whose output verdict is produced/empty_allowed. PR #1817 is proven by a communication_events row carrying an `· via n8n` footer.
definitions.provenance: Scheduler + lane named by the Telegram provenance footer `· via <n8n|cron|systemd> <lane>` (PR #1817) or run_id / source_job on the communication_events row. Anything else is UNKNOWN, never guessed.
definitions.refusal: A relay_log.jsonl row with state REFUSED for the lane (the run never started).
definitions.scheduler_ownership (S): n8n primary AND the cron copy is gone: either no active cron line plus a commented line tagged `RETIRED <date> n8n-cutover` / `N8N-ONLY TEST` (or a native n8n row), or EVERY active cron line runs scripts/effect_claim_cron.sh switched on for the lane (TRADEAI_EFFECT_CLAIM=<lane>) and the wrapper's LAST event for it in the window is skipped_effect / skipped_ownership_unknown (logs/effect_claim_events.jsonl: the cron copy fired and ran nothing). A wrapped line with no event yet, or whose last event ran the command, is NOT ownership.
definitions.unique_lane: A distinct lane_id (config/lane_registry.json, plus relay live-list names). A crontab line is attributed to the single best-ranked registry match (n8n_lane_disposition.match_rows); lines with no match are UNMAPPED.
definitions.unverified_ok: A live RUN_DONE receipt with exit 0 but no evaluated output verdict (missing, no_rule or declared_not_enforced). Exit 0 is NOT evidence of work (AGENTS §0 rule 8); counted, never called useful.
definitions.useful_live_output: A live RUN_DONE receipt whose output_verdict.verdict == 'produced'.
definitions.useful_output (U): >=1 live RUN_DONE whose output verdict is produced or empty_allowed.
definitions.verified_empty: A live RUN_DONE receipt whose output_verdict.verdict == 'empty_allowed' (declared, reasoned empty).
definitions.verified_recovery: The OUTPUT condition recovered: a CLEARED breach row after the last OPEN one, or the lane's declared output signal (file mtime / JSON key) is now newer than the last breach's detection, or (run failures) a later receipt of the same lane+mode is RUN_DONE with output verdict produced/empty_allowed (dry_run: RUN_DONE). A REQUESTED / shadow remediation row is NOT a heal; a lower alert count is NOT recovery.
